I am a Data Science master's student at the [Faculty of Electrical Engineering and Computing (FER)](https://www.fer.unizg.hr/en), University of Zagreb. 
For the 2026/27 academic year I am on exchange at [KU Leuven](https://www.kuleuven.be/english/).

I am interested in machine learning, more specifically **deep learning** and **natural language processing**. 
It is important to achieve an understanding and interpretability of how frontier AI models are trained, on how they think, reason and make decisions, 
ensuring that their internal processes are transparent, reliable, and aligned with human values.
